name: Takatori Castle
description: Takatori Castle, at 583 m, is one of Japan's three great mountain castles alongside Iwamura and Bitchu Matsuyama. Its stone walls rise among the forest; the ruins are a national historic site.
highlights: One of the three great mountain castles
notes: Free open-air site; a demanding climb from the Takatori station area — allow half a day.
businessHours: Open access (castle ruins; see official site for seasonal hours)
openingHoursJa: 城跡は自由に見学可（季節により開館時間が変わる施設あり）
